tasks.title: Make LogoLoader restart-tolerant, re-enable reactStrictMode
tasks.description: Refactor src/components/ui/logo-loader/logo-loader.tsx so the staggered SVG stroke-draw animation tolerates the Strict Mode mount→unmount→remount cycle without visibly restarting. Use animation-fill-mode: forwards with a one-shot trigger (or a sessionStorage gate keyed on session) so the animation completes once and stays in its final state across remounts. Then flip reactStrictMode: false → true in next.config.ts and remove the obsolete TODO block (lines 9-15). See PRD §Open Questions Q3 and next.config.ts:9-16.
acceptance: Strict Mode re-enabled in next.config.ts with no visible LogoLoader animation restart
tasks.notes: Resume mid-cycle via module-scoped origin + negative animation-delay in useLayoutEffect; useLayoutEffect gated by typeof window for SSR static export.

tasks.title: Add section ErrorBoundary on home + instrument hero Spline URL
tasks.description: Address [P0] Home dark-landscape crash. Create a small client-component ErrorBoundary at src/components/ui/error-boundary/error-boundary.tsx (React error boundary pattern, renders a tonal fallback with retry CTA). Wrap the home page sections in src/app/(home)/page.tsx so a render error stays scoped instead of bubbling to the global error boundary. In src/components/home/hero-section.tsx, add brief console-log instrumentation around Spline URL resolution to capture which scene URL is selected under dark × landscape; if a deterministic root cause surfaces, fix it and document in task notes. See PRD §Implementation Decisions / Modules and the companion decisions file §/ (home) [P0] block.
acceptance: Home page renders without crashing across viewport × theme combinations
tasks.notes: ErrorBoundary wraps all 4 home sections individually (HeroSection, FeaturedScholarships, WhatsNext, FAQSection) with descriptive labels. Hero adds dev-only console.info logging resolvedTheme + splineUrl + viewport. Probable [P0] root cause (per agent investigation, NOT yet fixed): scene-URL identity flip when next-themes resolves post-mount — initial render uses heroLight() with resolvedTheme=undefined, then re-renders with heroDark(), forcing @splinetool/react-spline to swap scenes mid-load. ErrorBoundary contains blast radius until a follow-up addresses the race (options: gate Spline render on mounted flag, or use suspense/key strategy that doesn't fully teardown WebGL).

tasks.title: Fix legal formatLastUpdated TZ + add Vitest test
tasks.description: In src/components/legal/legal-layout.tsx, add timeZone: "UTC" to LAST_UPDATED_FORMATTER (around lines 19-23) so Intl.DateTimeFormat parses the YYYY-MM-DD ISO string in UTC instead of the runtime's local timezone (eliminates off-by-one for users west of UTC). Export the formatter (or extract a formatLastUpdated() helper) so it is unit-testable. Add a Vitest test asserting formatLastUpdated("2026-05-14") returns "May 14, 2026" regardless of process.env.TZ — extend the existing src/components/legal/__tests__/legal-layout.component.test.tsx file or add a sibling. See PRD §Testing Decisions.
acceptance: Visitor sees correct legal Last updated date in their timezone
Vitest test asserts "May 14, 2026" output in a TZ=America/New_York run
tasks.notes: Added timeZone: "UTC" to LAST_UPDATED_FORMATTER; exported formatLastUpdated; 6 Vitest tests pass. Gotcha: module-level Intl.DateTimeFormat caches the formatter at import time so vi.stubEnv("TZ", ...) cannot override it — the UTC pin is what makes tests TZ-independent.

tasks.title: Global :focus-visible rule + scholarship grid breakpoints
tasks.description: Two surgical fixes. (1) Add a low-specificity global :focus-visible rule in src/app/globals.css using var(--secondary) (sage green) as the outline color, so every interactive element gets a visible focus ring (WCAG 2.4.7). Audit and remove any blanket outline-none usages that defeat the new rule. (2) In src/components/scholarships/scholarship-grid.tsx, change the grid columns to md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 so tablet landscape (1024px) renders 3 columns instead of 4 (fixes title truncation). See PRD §User Stories 2/5 and §Implementation Decisions / scholarship grid.
acceptance: Keyboard user sees a visible focus ring on every interactive element (WCAG 2.4.7)
Scholarship grid renders 3 columns at tablet landscape with no title truncation
tasks.notes: Added :focus-visible baseline using var(--secondary) outline; grid now md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Caveat: many components apply outline-none class which beats the element-selector baseline (class > tag specificity). Those components retain their own focus-visible:ring-* shadow rings, so accessible focus is preserved via component styles — the baseline only catches un-styled raw interactive elements. Follow-up: if WCAG audit flags missing rings on specific component-styled elements, add focus-visible:ring or focus-visible:outline to those components individually.

tasks.title: 404 Suspense fallback — static ZeroRing replaces pulsing dot
tasks.description: In src/components/ui/four-oh-four/not-found-client.tsx (around lines 166-170), replace the pulsing-dot Spline Suspense fallback with a static "404" ZeroRing visual that renders immediately while the Spline scene loads, so the literal 404 is visible within 1s on slow networks. Extract or inline a small ZeroRing component using existing OKLCH surface tokens — no new tokens. Keep the existing footer-aware container height behavior intact. See PRD §Implementation Decisions / not-found-client and companion decisions file §/not-found [P1] Spline loading state.
acceptance: 404 page shows a 404 indicator within 1s, before Spline resolves
tasks.notes: Suspense fallback now renders static "404" + ZeroRing immediately using bg-surface-container-low/40 + text-on-surface/70 (no glass). ZeroRing passed `reduced` prop in fallback so static SVG paints without Motion entrance delay. Fix-up 2026-05-16: removed pre-existing `mounted ? SplineScene : splineFallback` inline branch — the giant 25vw static 404 was painting pre-mount AND again as Suspense fallback, producing a visible double-404 flash. splineFallback is now exclusively the Suspense fallback (consumed only by <Suspense fallback={splineFallback}>); SplineScene renders directly. `mounted` flag retained for splineUrl theme-deterministic selection.

tasks.title: Contact MobileContactImage → useTheme()

Today the dark theme shows the light-mode image. Gate the theme-dependent src on a mounted state (or use resolvedTheme after mount) to avoid SSR mismatch and hydration warnings. See PRD §Implementation Decisions / contact and companion decisions file §/contact [P1] MobileContactImage.
acceptance: Dark mode contact phone image matches the active theme variant
tasks.notes: Converted MobileContactImage from <picture> media-query swap to useTheme/mounted-gated src; light variant rendered on SSR for deterministic hydration.
